the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: The tensor product is a quasi-coherent finite type module; at each point of the base its fibre decomposes as the tensor of the fibres by right exactness, the fibre of F is flat over the fibre of Y as a base change of a flat module, and the fibre of the composition is therefore the cycle associated to the tensor fibre by the action-coherent lemma, which is exactly the fibre of the claimed family (source lines 2853-2866)
